name: Context7
short_description: Fetch up-to-date, version-specific documentation for libraries and frameworks directly into your agent's context.
store_description: Context7 is a documentation MCP server that provides up-to-date, version-specific documentation and code snippets for any popular library or framework. LLMs often hallucinate outdated APIs because their training data has a cutoff. Context7 fixes this by fetching the latest official documentation for a specific library version and injecting it into the prompt. Supports thousands of libraries (React, Next.js, FastAPI, etc.). You can optionally use a free API key for higher rate limits.
description: Fetches up-to-date, version-specific documentation for libraries.

CONTEXT7_API_KEY.title: Context7 API Key (Optional)
CONTEXT7_API_KEY.description: Provides higher rate limits. Get a free key at https://context7.com

usage_hint: This MCP server provides up-to-date documentation for libraries. WORKFLOW: (1) First, use the 'resolve-library-id' tool to find the Context7 ID for the library you are using (e.g., 'react', 'nextjs'). (2) Then, use the 'get-library-docs' tool with that ID and an optional topic to fetch the official documentation directly into your context. Use this whenever you need to write code using a specific framework to avoid using outdated APIs.

hints.rate_limit: Higher limits with free API key
